fixed.summary: Prepares missing or stale cooked content before unit suites as well as playtests; --no-check skips types, not incremental preparation. Dev, run and build retain their automatic cook. Asset queries and project diagnostics refresh their reports themselves.

Author help, runtime errors, blob errors and the API reference no longer ask agents to cook by hand. Missing declarations name content IDs and declaration sources; incompatible hosts name the matching-tools fix. Platform/CI/troubleshooting og cook and the post-new .og/cook/look.json contract remain available.
